name: advanced-programming-part3
description:
Creates a Matchmaker object that is responsible for most of the arrangements. #### Matchmaker: #### Creates a Server. Accepts Clients and for each one creates: -- App -- Commands -- Validators Then starts a thread and waits for the next Client. #### Validators: #### AddValidator, GetValidator, SearchValidator, DeleteValidator (all implement IValidator) #### Commands: #### AddCommand, GetCommand, SearchCommand, DeleteCommand. Each command gets a reference to the encoder and its validator. A map> that connects command names ("add", "get", "search", "delete") to the corresponding ICommand objects and the requiresMuting boolean. Builds an App object with the menu + command map + common mutex + default-output string. Calls app.run(). #### App::run() – main loop #### Runs forever in a while(true) loop. #### On each iteration: #### Asks the menu for the next line of input: string line = menu->nextCommand(); #### Splits the line into: #### cmd → the first word (e.g. "add")
args → the rest of the line (e.g. "file1 some text") #### Looks up cmd in the commands map: #### If command does not exist → input is ignored (no output). Calls command->execute(args) on the matching ICommand. Takes the returned string result and passes it to the menu: menu->printOutput(result); Then the loop repeats and waits for the next user input. #### Each command validates + executes its logic #### At the start of every execute(): The command calls its validator: auto* parsed = validator.validate(args); If the validator returns nullptr → the input is invalid → the command returns an appropriate string and does nothing. If the validator returns a non-null pointer → input is valid, and the command continues with its logic (and frees the parsed list when done). #### Add Command (`add `) #### ➤ Validates that both a filename and text are provided. ➤ Compresses the text using RLE encoding. ➤ Saves the encoded content into a file under the files directory. #### Get Command (`get `) #### ➤ Validates that a single filename is provided. ➤ Reads the encoded content of the file and decodes it using RLE. ➤ Returns the original (decoded) text to the user. #### Search Command (`search `) #### ➤ Validates that a search term is provided. ➤ Scans all the files' names to find a match. ➤ Scans all files using an advanced algorithm that checks the compressed (encoded) data without decoding each file. ➤ Returns a list of filenames that contain the given search term. #### Result goes back to the user #### Whatever execute() returns is printed by the menu (unless it’s empty, in which case nothing is shown). Then the app goes back to waiting for the next command. #### Delete Command (`search `) #### ➤ Validates the arguments; ➤ Checks whether such a file exists. ➤ I does - removes and returns 204, else - returns 404.
